verdict.rationale: Lithic documents a sandbox that mirrors production, letting you run cards, transactions, and webhooks end-to-end. It also provides sandbox-only endpoints that simulate merchant-acquirer authorization events, so testing doesn't touch production data. Lithic's agentic-payments material walks through creating cards on a test account and running transactions against rules. Missing for 10: explicit docs that the MCP server or AI-editor workflow targets the sandbox (separate keys or base URL), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox's isolation and fidelity.
